scientific.integrity: The proof is an arbitrary-size first-force characterization under the positive semidefinite component rule. A standalone exhaustive checker independently reconstructs the process and verifies the criterion, every enumerator coefficient, and the minimum-size corollary on 269 small parameter profiles.
limitations: The theorem is restricted to complete multipartite graphs and positive semidefinite zero forcing.
The exhaustive computation reaches order eleven only; the all-size theorem rests on the symbolic proof.
The scalar minimum was proved previously and is not claimed as new.
Bibliographic searches cannot exclude an unindexed source using alternate terminology.

title: All positive semidefinite zero forcing sets of complete multipartite graphs
